description: Four-axis taxonomy for PerryLink DSH plugins. counts are derived from this file, not hand-written.

collections.description: Runtime, workflow, UX, research, integrations and developer experience.
53 core China compliance checkers plus 9 newer compliance tools.
15 public/synthetic domain tools and 2 one-command suites.

categories.description: Protect secrets, permissions, approvals and the local runtime.
Build, diagnose, test and evaluate DSH plugins.
Connect external services, people and inboxes.
Search, read, synthesize and publish research.
Inspect, transform and produce documents and content.
Clean, align, extract and analyze structured data.
See what the harness is doing and what it costs.
Change interaction, output style and visual surfaces.
Run finance, legal, ESG, quality, trade and logistics operations.
Check a register or record set against a versioned rule pack.
Install, discover, certify and serve plugins.

archetypes.description: Versioned rule pack/record set -> findings with locator and evidence; read-only.
Schema/format/check-digit validation without a versioned regulatory pack.
Diagnose install, runtime or capability state.
Inspect structure, hashes or diffs without adjudicating compliance.
Import, parse, dedupe and archive source material.
Pull structured fields out of documents or models.
Match two or more sources and produce a workpaper.
Track a stateful register or workflow.
Generate or complete a document draft.
Bridge an external service or channel.
Change UI, output style or interaction.
Change permissions, memory, routing or hooks.
Install members only; no tool surface.

rules: Each item has exactly one category and one archetype.
checker=true requires all five checker tests to pass.
category=compliance only when archetype=checker or collection=compliance.
kind=suite only when archetype=suite and members.length > 0.
A collection is not a marketplace category.
Counts must be generated from this file.

items.positioning: File-level OFD/XML invoice ingest, parse, dedupe and local archive; not tax-authority verification.
CAMT.053/MT940/GL ingest, 1:1 bank-to-GL match and a three-sheet workpaper.
Invoice/PO/GRN three-way match with a 1% default price tolerance and exception workpaper.
Order/invoice/card three-way match, duplicate check and a read-only amount/invoice policy check.
EML legal-request parse, classification, thread dedupe and ledger export.

items.displayNameZh: 合同条款与 playbook 审查
items.positioning: Clause tree plus a versioned 12-key playbook comparison and unresolved report; no legal conclusion.
Electricity activity ingest, location-based factor calculation, row verification and a partial ESRS E1 pack.
NCR ingest/dedupe, batch alias resolution, impact evaluation and CAPA/8D state tracking.
HS Top-3 candidates, 12-element completeness, simple RVC and tariff-version gate; not a binding classification.
Versioned ratecard, carrier-bill audit, recovery summary and variance export.
DOCX structure/hash inspection, byte-exact roundtrip, one exact-run replacement and text-level diff; not a tracked-changes writer.
IFC element/quantity inventory and CSV takeoff.
Read-only install doctor: capability snapshot, tarball assertion and install-log diagnosis; not a policy gate or ledger.
CSV catalog lint for required fields, duplicate SKU, GTIN check digit and price.
Public/synthetic eval-pack structure lint and deterministic JSON grading; not a validated benchmark.
